display.purpose: Hero and product-page h1; one accent phrase may be Dawn Ember.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono meta lines, kickers, notes.

motion.name: ray-cycle
motion.purpose: Logo ray color cycle; runs under reduced motion (color only).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled main action, e.g. Explore the apps.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#111214); border-radius:6px; text-decoration:none; font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-weight:600; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform .5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink,#111214); color: var(--bg,#f7f8f5); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--theme,#E8590C); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined companion action, e.g. Our principles.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#111214); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#111214); text-decoration:none; font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-weight:600; transition: background-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform .5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--surface,#fff); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--theme,#E8590C); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: EN / 繁中 pill toggle in the utility bar.
components.css: .ds-lang { display:inline-flex; padding:3px; border:1px solid var(--line,#c9cdd0); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface,#fff); } .ds-lang button { min-width:48px; min-height:34px; padding:5px 12px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted,#555b62); font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-lang button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--ink,#111214); color:var(--bg,#f7f8f5); } .ds-lang button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--theme,#E8590C); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Static feature label under each app.
components.css: .ds-tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; } .ds-tags li { padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line,#c9cdd0); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--ink,#111214); font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Library Card
components.description: npm package card with ink install bar and copy button.
components.html:
@dawn-studio/theme

Dark / light theme: localStorage, theme-color sync, no-flash head script.

npm i @dawn-studio/theme
components.css: .ds-lib { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; max-width:340px; padding:22px; border:1px solid var(--line,#c9cdd0); border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface,#fff); transition: border-color .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform .5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-lib:hover { border-color:var(--ink,#111214); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-lib-name { font:600 .95rem/1.3 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color:var(--ink,#111214); } .ds-lib p { margin:0; font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; color:var(--muted,#555b62); font-size:.95rem; line-height:1.55; } .ds-install { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 8px 8px 12px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--ink,#111214); } .ds-install code { flex:1; font:500 .82rem/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color:var(--bg,#f7f8f5); white-space:nowrap; overflow-x:auto; } .ds-copy { width:32px; height:32px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--bg,#f7f8f5); opacity:.55; cursor:pointer; padding:0; } .ds-copy:hover { opacity:1; background:rgba(128,128,128,.22); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--theme,#E8590C); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: App Illustration Plate
components.description: Shelf-hue plate with hard offset shadow holding a flat CSS illustration (Lo Shu grid shown).
components.css: .ds-plate { --project-color: #8458d8; display:grid; place-items:center; min-height:276px; max-width:420px; padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--ink,#111214); border-radius:12px; background:var(--project-color); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 rgba(17,18,20,.22); } .ds-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:10px; width:min(100%,230px); } .ds-grid span { aspect-ratio:1; display:grid; place-items:center; font:700 1.5rem Manrope, sans-serif; color:#f3a23b; background:#161719; border:1px solid #36383c; border-radius:12px; text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(227,168,87,.55); }

components.name: Mono Meta Label
components.description: Uppercase mono category line with the app's color dot.
components.css: .ds-meta { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:var(--muted,#555b62); font:500 .72rem/1.3 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-meta i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#3ddc84; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Underlined-by-rule link; turns Dawn Ember on hover, arrow nudges up-right.
components.html: Open OpenMusic
components.css: .ds-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding-bottom:4px; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; color:var(--ink,#111214); text-decoration:none; font-family: Manrope, 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-weight:700; transition: color .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link svg { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link:hover { color:var(--theme,#E8590C); } .ds-link:hover svg { transform:translate(3px,-3px); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--theme,#E8590C); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The whole system hangs off the logo: a Dawn Ember sun sitting on a horizon, with rays that cycle through a spectrum. Everything else is the quiet morning around it: a cool off-white paper, near-black ink, hairline rules and monospace labels. Color is not spread across the chrome; it arrives the way light does, from one source, and lands on each app as its own hue on the shelf.

The mood is clean, direct and playful. The page itself is plain, ruled and typographic: huge tightly-tracked Manrope headlines, a mono meta line under each app name, and thin dividers that turn sections into a list. The play is concentrated in the per-app illustration cards (a spinning-feeling vinyl, a UFO over a green night sky, a Lo Shu number grid, stacked clipboard cards), each drawn in flat CSS shapes on that app's color. Components stay quiet and precise so those cards can carry the personality.

Light and dark are both first-class and follow `prefers-color-scheme`. EN and 繁中 share the same layout; Chinese gets looser line-height on display type.
keyCharacteristics: One warm sun (Dawn Ember) as the only chrome accent; app hues live only on the shelf.
Oversized, negative-tracked sans headlines over uppercase mono labels.
Hairline-ruled sections; the page reads as a catalogue, not a grid of cards.
Flat-shape CSS illustrations, one per app, each on its own color plate.
Quiet, precise components: ink-filled or outlined, small radius, short eased transitions.

rules.name: The One Sun Rule
rules.body: Dawn Ember is the only accent in the page chrome. App hues stay on the shelf and never color navigation, buttons or section headings.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Headlines track at −0.04em (the floor; never tighter) with line-height under 1 in English. In 繁中, display line-height opens to 1.08 and headlines to 1.15 so characters do not collide.

rules.name: The Mono Labels Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, counts or categorises (meta lines under titles, numbers in illustrations) is IBM Plex Mono uppercase with wide tracking. Prose is never mono.

dos: Do keep Dawn Ember as the single chrome accent: the headline accent word, the focus ring, link hover.
Do give every new app a shelf hue, a mono meta line with a matching dot, and a flat CSS illustration plate.
Do separate sections with rules (strong ink under section heads, hairline between items) instead of wrapping them in boxes.
Do ship every string in EN and 繁中, and check the 繁中 line-heights on display type.
Do define colors as tokens with dark-mode counterparts; illustration internals use the fixed illustration ink and paper.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: scroll reveals and transitions turn off, and only the color-only ray cycle keeps running.
donts: Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading; category and platform lines go under the title.
Don't number list items (01, 02…) unless the order carries meaning.
Don't use app shelf hues on navigation, buttons or section headings.
Don't set prose in IBM Plex Mono or set labels in Manrope.
Don't draw the sun's rays as alternating red-and-white bands radiating to the edges. Keep them as short spectrum strokes above the horizon.
Don't add soft blurred shadows to page chrome; depth stays in the illustrations.
